Please send any inquiries about partnerships, data, or collaborations to: [slamdunkbettingservices@gmail.com](mailto:slamdunkbettingservices@gmail.com)

For all other questions or support, hit us up on X at [\@slam_dunk_bets](https://x.com/slam_dunk_bets) or [\@jimtheflash](https://x.com/jimtheflash) for the fastest response&nbsp;time. Subscribers can also ask in the Discord.

For questions about payment processing, please first reach out to our payment processing partners, either [Sharpduel](https://www.sharpduel.com) or [Whop](https://www.whop.com), before reaching out to our customer support (our first course of action is to try the payment processor).
